title: Tempted in the Wilderness

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Right after His baptism, the Spirit led Jesus out into the dry, rocky wilderness.

bsb: If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.
kjv: If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

bsb: It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’
kjv: It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jesus was very hungry, but He answered with the words of Scripture.

bsb: Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.
kjv: Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

puzzle.hint: We live on everything God says.

scenes.title: The Pinnacle of the Temple
scenes.note: Luke 4:1-13 tells these same temptations, but lists the last two in a different order. This game follows Matthew's order.

bsb: If You are the Son of God
throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’
kjv: If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

bsb: It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’
kjv: It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

puzzle.prompt: The devil took Jesus to the holy city. Tap Jerusalem on the map.
puzzle.hint: Jerusalem is in Judea, in the hills west of the Dead Sea.

bsb: All this I will give You
if You will fall down and worship me.
kjv: All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

bsb: For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’
kjv: Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three times Jesus was tempted, and three times He answered with God's Word.

puzzle.prompt: How did Jesus answer the devil each time?
puzzle.hint: Listen for the words “It is written.”

bsb: Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.
kjv: Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

reflect: When we are tempted, God's Word helps us choose what is right.
